title: Lazy Assignment and Addition
statement:
Implement a lazy segment tree for interleaved inclusive range assignment, range addition, and range-sum queries.

Input
Read n q and n initial values. Then read q operations. SET L R X assigns X to every value in the range. ADD L R X adds X to every value in the range. SUM L R asks for the range sum.

Output
For every SUM, print its answer in operation order.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 200000, 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ n. Initial values and X have absolute value at most 10⁶.

samples.input:
5 8
1 2 3 4 5
ADD 1 5 2
SET 2 4 0
SUM 1 5
ADD 3 5 -1
SUM 3 5
SET 1 5 4
ADD 2 3 3
SUM 1 4
